main_topics.reason: The user described repeatedly being flattened for days after walks or beginner yoga and asked how to reconcile this with advice to exercise.
The user engaged with advice to start very small and described overdoing activity on good days, then crashing.
The user said they felt stuck and punished by the mismatch between common advice and their body's response, and later described years of overdoing or giving up.
The user asked whether walking or yoga was better and showed interest in trying the community-center pool.
The user asked how long it might take to notice a difference and accepted that progress could be gradual.

output.summary: The user with fibromyalgia described delayed crashes after walking or beginner yoga and wanted practical advice on exercising without triggering them. The assistant suggested starting at a very small tolerated level, pacing activity on good days, considering warm-water movement, and tracking gradual changes; the user said the advice helped and appreciated the realistic expectations.
